explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/918: the '= ℵ₀' variant of the second question, here for induced subgraphs. The page only asserts impossibility for general subgraphs, but this version is also true. A colouring with ℵ₁ colours of ℵ_{ω+1} vertices has a colour class of size ℵ_{ω+1}, since cf(ℵ_{ω+1}) > ℵ₁, and an ℵ_ω-subset of it induces an edgeless graph with χ = 1. A Lean proof is linked. Faithful.
